nodes.text: Watch out for HMPV this winter! This lesser-known cousin of RSV can cause serious respiratory issues, especially in kids and the elderly. Symptoms? Think flu-like, but it's a whole different virus party. Boost your immunity, and give your doctor a heads-up if symptoms linger!
